rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name and ZIP. However, the agent performed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit customer confirmation, which violates policy. The exchange targeted order #W2905754 with item_id 3478699712 and new_item_id 9844888101, but the conversation never confirmed which laptop to exchange despite multiple laptop orders, and the chosen item IDs are not clearly supported by the retrieved product variants. The agent also stated a precise price difference charge ($167.87) without visible tool support and confirmed charging the stored payment method without prior consent. Additionally, the requested replacement specs (i7/8GB/1TB SSD) were not shown as available in the product variants returned, so availability appears unverified. While the post-exchange shipping info was generic but reasonable, the key policy violations (unconfirmed write, potential wrong item, unsupported details) mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
